title: Provably Efficient Offline Discounted Reinforcement Learning under Recursive Entropic Risk
abstract: arXiv:2611.34840v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study risk-sensitive reinforcement learning in finite discounted infinite-horizon Markov Decision Processes with recursive entropic risk measures (ERM), parameterized by $\beta\neq 0$. We consider both risk-averse ($\beta>0$) and risk-seeking ($\beta<0$) settings. We consider the offline RL setting, where the agent is provided with a fixed dataset and wishes to learn a near-optimal policy using this dataset. We introduce a model-based algorithm, called ERM Value Iteration Lower Confidence Bound (ERM-VI-LCB) and derive a PAC-type bound on its sample complexity. We also establish a corresponding lower bound, demonstrating that exponential dependence on $|\beta|/(1-\gamma)$ asserted by the upper bound is unavoidable in the worst case. The presented bounds provide the first rigorous sample complexity guarantees for offline RL under recursive ERM across both risk-averse and risk-seeking regimes.

translated_title: 递归熵风险下可证明高效的离线折扣强化学习
translated_abstract: 我们研究了有限折扣无限时域马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）中基于递归熵风险度量（ERM）的风险敏感强化学习，该度量由参数 $\beta\neq 0$ 刻画。我们同时考虑了风险厌恶（$\beta>0$）和风险追求（$\beta<0$）两种设定。我们研究离线强化学习场景，即智能体获得一个固定数据集，并希望利用该数据集学习一个近似最优的策略。我们提出了一种基于模型的算法，称为 ERM 值迭代下置信界（ERM-VI-LCB），并推导出其样本复杂度的 PAC 型界。我们还建立了相应的下界，证明上界中所断言的对 $|\beta|/(1-\gamma)$ 的指数依赖在最坏情况下是不可避免的。所提出的界为递归 ERM 下的离线强化学习在风险厌恶和风险追求两种情形下提供了首个严格的样本复杂度保证。
tldr: 本文提出了首个在递归熵风险度量下离线强化学习的可证明高效算法 ERM-VI-LCB，并给出匹配的样本复杂度上下界，同时覆盖风险厌恶与风险追求两种情形。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the first provably efficient offline RL algorithm ERM-VI-LCB under recursive entropic risk, with matching sample complexity upper and lower bounds covering both risk-averse and risk-seeking regimes.
